objective.summary: S0/K0 documentation-only audit for the ALIPROMPT Prompt Knowledge Network; canonical envelope is S0, START, G0/G1, requested exit S0_ACCEPTED.
objective.businessReason: Prevent later knowledge-network implementation from treating an approved target, roadmap, broad dirty worktree, or template acceptance labels as verified predecessor evidence.
desiredOutcomes: A reviewer can distinguish CURRENT repository facts from APPROVED NEXT product target and GAP/BLOCKED items.
A future S1 or K1 invocation is denied until an independently accepted S0 artifact binds revision, environment, gates, evidence, reviewer, decision, and timestamp.
K0 data, ADR, migration, security, analytics, and rollback requirements are explicit without changing application code.

included: S0 and K0 repository, contract, sprint-sequencing, runtime, schema, route, test, dirty-tree, and evidence audit.
Task Contract and schema-valid handoff creation only.
K0 data-inventory and future reversible migration requirements.
excluded: Any S1-S7 or K1-K6 implementation, application, schema, migration, dependency, provider, deployment, production, DNS, payment, or runtime change.
Acceptance or release claim for S0, K0, PK-01 through PK-24, or any later sprint.
Reference-site code, assets, copy, data, prompts, or private APIs.
assumptions: The active product contract v1.4.0 is approved target intent, not implementation or acceptance evidence.
All pre-existing dirty and untracked application paths remain user or concurrent work unless a future explicit ownership handoff says otherwise.
The absence of an in-repository schema-valid accepted handoff means later-sprint dispatch is fail-closed.
constraints: No application code or runtime configuration may be written in S0.
Independent qa-release-reviewer review is required before S0_ACCEPTED.
No secret, raw PII, protected prompt body, signed URL, payment payload, or reference content is recorded.

decisions.context: AP-PDN-001 requires the catalog-to-knowledge migration to be additive, idempotent, reversible, and reconciled before cutover.
optionsConsidered: Rewrite or drop legacy prompt tables.
Future additive map, backfill, verify, compatibility read/feature flags, cutover, and separate contract step.
decisions.choice: Reserve the additive reversible approach for a later approved schema slice; perform no migration in S0.
decisions.rationale: Current runtime database volume, identity mapping, file types, moderation backlog, provider bindings, and reconciliation evidence are unknown.
consequences: K0 must inventory row counts, null distributions, PII classes, file types, hashes, and legacy mapping exceptions before schema work.
No production or local data mutation occurs in this task.

decisions.context: The PRD reserves several behavior-changing numeric and policy values for S0 owner decision.
optionsConsidered: Invent numerical values in code or documentation.
Keep values unresolved and require explicit owner decisions with rationale, scope, and rollback.
decisions.choice: Keep the values unresolved and route OD-S0-01 through OD-S0-07 to the human owner using the decision packet in the S0/K0 Task Contract.
decisions.rationale: The active contract and PRD explicitly forbid inventing the WVSA target, file cap changes, self-accept wait, reputation policy, moderation SLA, tag set, and retention/appeal policy.
consequences: K1-K6 behavior that depends on these values remains blocked or uses only already-approved safe behavior explicitly listed in the owner decision packet.
An owner decision record is required before any material behavior change.
